shadows.name: subtle-inset
shadows.purpose: Frosted top edge highlight on sticky navigation

motion.name: utility-ease
motion.purpose: Fast utility transitions for hover, day stepping, and state changes

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA fill for high-leverage resolution actions
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4f46e5; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { background: transparent; color: #0c0a08; border: 1px solid #0c0a08; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: #f4f2f0; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Primary flat white surface with hairline border
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px 24px; color: #0c0a08; }

narrative.overview: MAVI operates as a black-and-white editorial system punctuated by a single electric cobalt accent — the visual equivalent of an executive finance audit with an indigo marker. The interface stays nearly monochrome: warm off-white canvas, white cards, hairline gray borders, and deep near-black text.
keyCharacteristics: Single chromatic signal (MAVI Indigo #4f46e5 reserved for CTAs/active triggers)
Flat hairline elevation (1px #e5e7eb outlines over shadows)

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: #4f46e5 is reserved strictly for interactive actions and live status triggers.

rules.name: The Single-Weight Rule
rules.body: Use weight 400 exclusively; hierarchy comes from size and tracking.

rules.name: The No-Side-Tab Rule
rules.body: Thick colored left/right border stripes on cards are prohibited.

dos: Do use lausanne at weight 400 exclusively
Do reserve #4f46e5 indigo strictly for active CTAs
Do rely on 1px #e5e7eb hairline borders for separation
Do use tabular-nums for numeric alignment
donts: Don't use border-l-4 or thick side-tab borders on cards
Don't use font-mono on non-code UI labels or status badges
Don't apply drop shadows to content cards or panels
Don't use multicolor gradients or glassmorphism blurs
